statement.description: One CQL SELECT, such as SELECT * FROM shop.orders WHERE customer_id = ? LIMIT 50. Filter by the partition key; ALLOW FILTERING is refused.

values.description: Values of the markers: an array for ?, in order, or an object for :name. By column type: strings for text, uuid, inet, date (2026-11-11), time and duration; numbers (bigint, varint and decimal also as strings); true or false; timestamps as ISO-8601 or epoch milliseconds; blobs as 0x hex; arrays for list, set, tuple and vector; objects for map and UDT.

limit.description: Most rows to return; the endpoint caps it.

cursor.description: nextCursor of the previous answer, with the same statement and values; leave it out for the first page.
